request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

audit.proof_assessment: The five prior T4A2 live-oracle defects are closed in the candidate openAgentStudio path, judged from the harness text rather than the WIDTHS=1440 receipt. (1) Duplicate retry GET now registers waitForRequest(/api/ai-teammates/ GET, 750ms) before evaluate(click), requires TimeoutError→false, then re-reads rosterGetCount === initial+1 while attempt 0 is still held. (2) During the hold it asserts aria-disabled=true and getAttribute('disabled')===null before the forced click, so HTMLElement.click() can actually exercise the product guard. (3) POST finally releases, awaits postResponse?.catch, then unroute; the waiter is bound to the exact Request. (4) Idle · Read + propose is counted via evaluateAll filtered on display/visibility and non-zero box, not locator.count(). (5) aria-describedby tokens are resolved with getElementById and compared to the exact safety-help string. Initial 503 copy is locator.waitFor (visible default); failed retry asserts activeElement on Try again after 'Retry still unavailable.'; successful retry asserts activeElement on the first restored radio after the 200. Receipt exit 0 is only a run log.
residual_risks: Native-disabled is sampled before waitFor('Trying the local roster again…'), not in the same turn as evaluate(click); a later native disabled would make the duplicate click a no-op and still pass.
Idle visibility matches Playwright box semantics only; 1px/sr-only copies still count; aria-hidden is not filtered.
Retry waitForResponse matchers are any GET 503/200 on /api/ai-teammates/, not the held Request object (POST is identity-bound).
Unexpected POST during the radio-Enter probe leaves postResponse unset, so finally can unroute a held handler.
Glob **/api/ai-teammates/* is one path segment; deeper or query-only URLs are invisible to rosterGetCount/postCount.
Second retry asserts exact +1 GET with no extra bounded negative wait.
Strict Mode double-fetch still fail-closes the exact +1 count.
